Images are omitted from output when skipImages is true

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"skip_images\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Before <img src='test.jpg' alt='photo'> After</p>", options)
```
